{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies mempool configuration bounds in src/node/mempool_args.cpp and adds unit tests in src/test/mempool_tests.cpp.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.3,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Bounds checking prevents policy anomalies such as negative -datacarriersize allowing unlimited OP_RETURN sizes and negative or huge -mempoolexpiry overflowing time conversions. These fixes improve policy parameter robustness against extreme misconfigurations."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies argument handling and startup sequencing in src/init.cpp and subsystem argument parsing files, updating help placeholders and negation flags.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Enforcing bounds on numeric startup arguments prevents silent integer wrap-arounds and unexpected logic inversions across node configuration options. Providing fatal startup errors instead of silent misconfigurations improves user-facing argument handling, though doing so via piecemeal checks rather than centralized parsing limits its leverage."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/node/chainstatemanager_args.cpp and src/node/coins_view_args.cpp to bounds-check -maxtipage and -dbbatchsize CLI arguments.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Validating startup CLI options does not substantively alter consensus rules, UTXO management, or validation engine invariants."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches src/wallet/init.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.cpp and adds test coverage in test/functional/wallet_fallbackfee.py.",
      "band": "P4",
      "score": 0.15,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Rejecting out-of-range -txconfirmtarget arguments prevents wallet transactions from silently falling back to -fallbackfee. This resolves a narrow edge-case misconfiguration without altering broader wallet behavior."
    }
  ],
